items.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025
items.q: a teacher named Grandmother Twylah Nitsch. So she was very much an inspiration for that.

ctx.x: Yeah. I wondered if someone tried to pin you down about the recordings that you’re most proud of, is there a short list?

Well yeah, one is called “Fifth World Anthem,” it’s dedicated to the Native American sensibility and a teacher named Grandmother Twylah Nitsch. So she was very much an inspiration for that. And Miles was inspiration for that too. Oh what else?
